description: Scan a website's agent-trust-readiness and return a signed scorecard (Trust, plus an Access axis on newer rubrics). Zero-auth. Results are CACHED for up to 24h — check `cached` and `scannedAt` on the result; pass `fresh: true` to force a re-scan (rate-limited). Proxies to the SSRF-locked isittrustready scanner; the Ed25519 signature + permalink are preserved verbatim. Rubric + docs: https://www.isittrustready.ai/rubric and https://docs.mnemom.ai/.

fresh.description: Force a fresh re-scan instead of the cached result (results are cached up to 24h; the engine rate-limits re-scans). Equivalent to the scanner's rescan flag.

url.description: Domain or URL to scan, e.g. "example.com" or "https://example.com".

name: scan_trust

outputSchema.description: Signed iitr two-axis trust-readiness scorecard (returned verbatim). Verify it in-band with the verify_scan tool, or follow the rule + key in the scorecard's own `verification` block (Ed25519 against mnemom://iitr/jwks; canonicalization strips [signature, cached, permalink, verification]).

access.description: The independent Access/discoverability axis (never blended with Trust). Present from the two-axis rubric (0.3.0+).

applicable.description: False when the site declares Access N/A.

version.description: Access-axis rubric version this sub-score was computed against.

cached.description: True when served from the scanner's 24h cache rather than a fresh scan.

categories.description: Trust-axis categories with per-category scores + checks.

permalink.description: Shareable /r/ permalink (only on /r/ responses; transport field).

scannedAt.description: When this scorecard was produced. Results are cached up to 24h — pass fresh:true to scan_trust to force a re-scan.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical result (transport field; stripped before verify).

verification.description: Self-describing in-band verification block {alg, kid, jwks, canonicalization} — how to verify this scorecard's signature. Self-describing, so signed-EXCLUDED (stripped before verify).
